recipes.name: Sandy Frye's Appetizers inspired by Bob's Burgers
ingredients: 5 1/2 slices jalapeños, seeded and diced (with additional for garnish)
instructions: For The Puff Pastry #1
Add all purpose flour to a bowl along with cold cubed butter and a pinch of salt. - 8 ½ ounces all purpose flour - 4 ounces cold Butter cubed - Kosher Salt

Mix dough using a pastry blender, 2 butter knives or your fingers, until the butter is in chunks the size of peas. After that add ice cold water and then mix together until a crumbly yet cohesive dough has formed. - ¾ cup Ice Water
Turn out the dough onto your work surface and knead it together until it is one unified ball. Wrap in plastic wrap and place in the fridge for 30 minutes.

Remove the dough from the fridge and roll out to about a 12x4 inch rectangle. Fold into thirds and then roll out again. Do this a few times until you get a semi-smooth dough. Cover and place back in the fridge for 15 minutes.
In a food processor, grate frozen butter and place in a bowl with flour, and set aside. - 1 stick cold Butter cubed - sprinkle all purpose flour

Remove the dough from the fridge and put half of the grated butter on the puff pastry, fold into thirds and roll out. Roll out twice before adding the rest of the butter and then fold and roll out 2 more times.
Roll your puff pastry out one final time and it’s ready to use.
For The Puff Pastry #2
Place flour in a medium bowl. Cut in butter until mixture is the size of small peas. - 8 ½ ounces all purpose flour - 8 ounces cold butter cubed
Add sour cream. Stir with a fork until pastry forms a ball. Wrap in plastic and chill overnight. When ready to use, roll pastry thinly. - ½ cup sour cream
For The Sesame Cheddar Blasts
Place some cheddar cheese on half of your rolled out puff pastry and then cover by folding the puff pastry in half. Roll it out and then cut into ½ inch wide strips. - Cheddar cheese
Twist them into twists and place them on a parchment lined baking sheet. Brush them with sesame oil and top with some sesame seeds. - Sesame oil - Sesame Seeds
Place in a 400°F oven for 15 minutes and cook until golden brown and flaky.
Remove from oven, let cool, and then serve and enjoy.
For The Toasted Jalapeño Points

In a bowl combine softened cream cheese with seeded and diced jalapeños along with mozzarella cheese. Stir to combine. - 8 ounces cream cheese softened - 5 ½ slices jalapeños seeded and diced (with additional for garnish) - 6 ounces mozzarella shredded

Roll out your store bought pastry and cut into even squares. Beat the eggs in a bowl and brush egg wash along all 4 edges of puff pastry square. Place a dollop of your cream cheese mixture in the middle and fold it over on itself. Crimp the edges shut and then brush outside with an egg wash. - Store bought puff pastry - 2 eggs
Season with salt and place a slice of jalapeño in the middle as a garnish.
Place in a 400°F oven for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool then serve and enjoy!
For The Mozzarella Volcano

Roll out your puff pastry and then cut into strips. Cover entire puff pastry with grated parmesan, romano, and mozzarella cheese. - Parmesan cheese grated - Romano cheese grated - Mozzarella cheese grated
Beat one egg and brush the tops and bottoms of the puff pastry with the egg wash. - 1 Egg
Roll each strip from one end to the other forming a little volcano.
Add volcanos to a parchment lined baking sheet and bake at 400°F for 15-20 minutes.
Remove and let cool.
Add some warm tomato sauce to the top so it looks more like a volcano. - Warm tomato sauce
Serve and enjoy.
